name: teollimi
description: Publicly reported data breaches by company, recent breaches, open settlements and what to do after a breach notice, with sources.

interface.shortDescription: Data breach history, open settlements and next steps, with sources
interface.longDescription: Ask whether a company or the services you use have had a data breach, what leaked, whether compensation or fines followed, which US settlements are still taking claims, and what to do after a breach notice. Answers come from incidents Teollimi confirmed through press reports and official announcements in Korea, Japan, the US and elsewhere, each with its source and a link to the full page. Read-only, no sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Has Ticketmaster had a data breach? Give me sources.
I use Coupang, Netflix and AT&T. Were any of them breached?
Which data breach settlements can I still claim?
